tasks.title: Implement comment deletion API
tasks.description: Add the backend capability to delete a single comment from a specific issue. The service must validate that the comment exists and belongs to the resolved issue before deleting, and the API must expose DELETE /api/issues/:number/comments/:commentId with clear 404 behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: DELETE /api/issues/:number/comments/:commentId deletes a comment that belongs to the requested issue
Deleting a missing comment returns a 404 response with a clear error message
Deleting a comment that belongs to a different issue returns a 404 response and does not delete it
Deleting a comment does not delete the issue or any other issue's comments
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Consumes existing CommentRepo.findById/delete and produces the API consumed by CLI and Web tasks. No schema migration is expected.

tasks.title: Add CLI comment deletion
tasks.description: Add a CLI command for deleting a comment from an issue while preserving the existing mo issue comment <number> <text> add-comment command. Update mo issue show <number> so each comment displays an id or copyable short/full id that users can pass to the delete command.
acceptanceCriteria: mo issue show <number> displays an id or short id for each listed comment
mo issue delete-comment <number> <comment-id> calls the DELETE comment endpoint
Successful deletion prints Deleted comment <id> from issue #<number>
The existing mo issue comment <number> <text> command still adds comments
Delete-command help and error text clearly refer to comments, not issues
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Consumes the DELETE API produced by T-001. Prefer mo issue delete-comment to avoid ambiguity with the existing positional comment command.

tasks.title: Add Web comment deletion
tasks.description: Add Web UI support for deleting a comment from the issue detail page. Each comment should expose a lightweight Delete action with confirmation, pending state, error handling, and refreshed issue detail after success.
acceptanceCriteria: Each comment in IssueDetailPage exposes a Delete action
Clicking Delete asks for confirmation before sending the request
The active delete action shows a pending/disabled state while deletion is in progress
Deletion failure displays an understandable error without removing the comment from the UI
Deletion success refreshes issue detail or otherwise removes the deleted comment from the displayed list
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Consumes the DELETE API produced by T-001. Query invalidation is preferred over optimistic local deletion for the MVP.

tasks.title: Verify comment management behavior
tasks.description: Add or update automated coverage for the completed comment deletion workflow across backend, CLI, and Web where existing test infrastructure supports it. Verify ownership checks, not-found handling, preserved add-comment behavior, visible comment ids, and UI delete success/failure behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: Backend tests cover successful deletion, missing comment 404, and cross-issue comment 404 without deleting the foreign comment
CLI tests or equivalent command verification cover comment id display and successful delete-comment output
Web tests or equivalent component verification cover confirmation, pending state, failure display, and successful refresh/removal
Existing comment creation behavior remains covered or manually verified
Tests pass
Typecheck passes
tasks.output: packages/cli/tests and/or packages/cli/web test files for comment deletion coverage
tasks.notes: Consumes all feature outputs. If a layer lacks practical test harness coverage, document the manual verification command/output in the task result.
